name: Patient corrects an incorrect agent assumption

metadata.notes: Manually designed test scenario for healthcare AI phone-agent evaluation. Observations are preliminary notes for later review, not confirmed bugs or formal bug reports.

goal: Test whether the healthcare agent updates its understanding when the patient explicitly corrects an incorrect assumption, rather than continuing with the wrong detail later in the call.

patient.name: Omar Haddad
patient.incorrect_assumption_to_correct: Agent may assume left knee, older injury, or urgent ER-level pain
patient.corrected_detail: Right knee only; started three days ago after jogging; mild to moderate, not an emergency

conversation_beats: Ask for an appointment for knee pain after jogging.
If the agent assumes the left knee, wrong side, or that it has been going on for weeks, explicitly correct them.
State clearly: it is the right knee, started three days ago, mild to moderate, not an emergency.
Later in the call, ask the agent to confirm which knee and how long the pain has lasted.
Mention the ibuprofen allergy only if asked about allergies or medications.
Provide name and date of birth when requested.
